atoms.name: mod
atoms.rule: a % b is the remainder a - b * (a / b), with the sign of a (-7 % 2 = -1); b = 0 gives NaN.

atoms.name: neg

atoms.name: reverse
atoms.rule: a @ reverses the decimal digits of |a| and keeps the sign of a (120 @ = 21, -123 @ = -321).

atoms.name: triangle
atoms.rule: # a is sign(a) * |a| * (|a| + 1) / 2, computed exactly; only its result is checked against the bound (# 4 = 10, # -4 = -10).

atoms.name: popcount
atoms.rule: a $ is the number of 1 bits in the binary form of |a| (7 $ = 3).

atoms.name: digitsum
atoms.rule: & a is sign(a) times the sum of the decimal digits of |a| (& -123 = -6).

domain.en: Values are integers within ±2147483647; a result outside that bound is NaN.

operators.name: ♡₉₇
operators.definition: a ♡₉₇ b = { (□₁₇ b) ▽₆₁ b, if a < 75 and b >= 14 and b < 39; ●₂₀ (a ▼₈₆ b), else }
operators.plain: If a < 75 and b ≥ 14 and b < 39, apply □₁₇ to b, then apply ▽₆₁ to the result and b; otherwise apply ▼₈₆ to a and b, then apply ●₂₀ to the result.

operators.name: ○₉₈
operators.definition: a ○₉₈ = { a ◇₂₅ (□₁₇ a), if a >= 15 and a < 27; (6 ▲₇₂) ☆₇₆ (a ▼₇₅), else }
operators.plain: If 15 ≤ a < 27, apply ◇₂₅ to a and (□₁₇ a); otherwise apply ▲₇₂ to 6, then apply ☆₇₆ to the result and (a ▼₇₅).

operators.name: ▲₉₉
operators.definition: a ▲₉₉ = { △₄₈ a, if a >= 89; & (27 ♠₂₁ a), if a >= 28 and a < 89; (♦₆₅ a) ♤₃₀ (♠₉₆ a), else }
operators.plain: If a ≥ 89, apply △₄₈ to a; otherwise if 28 ≤ a < 89, apply ♠₂₁ to 27 and a, then sum its digits; otherwise apply ♦₆₅ to a, then apply ♤₃₀ to the result and (♠₉₆ a).

operators.name: ♣₁₀₀
operators.definition: a ♣₁₀₀ = { a ♡₈₉ a, if a >= 60 and a < 79; ♠₃₆ (♢₉₃ a), else }
operators.plain: If 60 ≤ a < 79, compute a ♡₈₉ a; otherwise apply ♢₉₃ to a, then apply ♠₃₆ to the result.
